description: A handful of figures with their labels, ranked so the first leads (emphasis role, accent ink) and the rest read as its comparison; set side by side when the box is wide enough, else as label-left, figure-right lines. Never tiles. Ported from deckgen's kpi_row seed.

metrics.label: string
metrics.value: string, the figure as written (the data's own precision)

data_schema._id: instance id prefix, set by the slide

variants.horizontal: flex row of one column per metric: figure over its label
variants.stacked: flex column of rows: label (takes the rest) beside its figure (as wide as the widest figure measures)

variant_rule: deckgen's: parts >= 2 and width // parts >= height, with parts = the metric count; plus every figure must measure onto one line in its horizontal column, else stacked

tests.held_out_box_note: deckgen's held-out strip is 9,144,000 wide, the whole 4:3 keybank slide; with the harness margins it ran past the slide (validation: shape extends past the slide), so the held-out box is keybank's content width, 9,144,000 - 2 x space.margin 381,000

single_line_rule: a figure never wraps: '$1' over '4' is a misread number
